cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept your apology for breaking the vase. You remembered our rule about saying what you did instead of 'something happened'.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're offering a repair without prompting. The vase was cheap, though. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for watching me scold him while you stayed quiet. Use the whole sentence, as I taught you. Replacing the vase won't tell me you understand that part.
